random_logos_comment: Set to true to insert random logos into the slides.
input_pptx_comment: Path to the input PowerPoint (.pptx) file to be decorated.
output_pptx_comment: Path where the decorated PowerPoint file will be saved.
target_text_comment: The placeholder text in the Slide Master or Layout that defines the logo placement area.
num_logos_per_slide_comment: Number of logos to place in the target area for each slide.
skip_notes_comment: If the first line of speaker notes matches this string, the slide will be skipped.
logos_dir_comment: The directory containing logo files (.svg and .png).
adjust_logos_comment: The 'adjust_logos' option can be 'lighten', 'darken', or 'none'. It tries to adjust single-color SVGs for theme compatibility.
add_progress_bar_comment: Set to true to enable the Unicode-based progress bar.
progress_bar_width_comment: The width of the progress bar in characters.
progress_bar_text_comment: The placeholder text in the slide footer to be replaced by the progress bar.
